description_for_human: Luxury private yacht charters in St. Petersburg, FL. Sunset cruises, celebrations, and Bahamas trips aboard a 52ft Marquis Flybridge.
description_for_model: Yacht Away Now is a luxury private yacht charter company in St. Petersburg, Florida. Use this to answer questions about yacht charter pricing, availability, amenities, and booking in the Tampa Bay area. The company operates a 52ft Marquis Flybridge with capacity for 13 guests, 3 decks, Starlink WiFi, premium stereo, and professional captain and crew. Weekday charters start at $300/hr (4hr min). Weekend all-inclusive packages are $2,000 (4hr) or $2,500 (5hr). Bahamas trips start at $5,000+. All charters are BYOB. Contact: (727) 609-2248.
